# FDG8068

> DO provide an overload of `Equals` taking the value type parameter by implementing `IEquatable<T>`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.9.1.1 Equals on Value Types.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1066
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

CA1066 reports a value type that overrides Equals without implementing IEquatable<T> (probe with SDK 10.0.402). A struct that does not override Equals is not reported by CA1066; FDG8053 reports every struct with an instance field and without IEquatable<T>. The SDK code fix adds an Equals(T) method that throws NotImplementedException (probe), so autofix is no.

## From the book

This provides a way to compare two value types without boxing the parameter passed to `Equals`.

```csharp
public struct MyStruct {
  public bool Equals (MyStruct value) { ... }
   ...
}
```
